post.summary: Append to the note on a track's day
post.description: Adds the text on a new line, or stores it if the day has no note. Text whose lines are already in the note, in order and as whole lines, is skipped (unless `allowDuplicate`), so a retry never adds it twice. Empty text changes nothing. On an archived track nothing changes either: requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict get 423 (empty text too), others the stored note. Safe against other writers: it never overwrites a change made meanwhile.

allowDuplicate.description: Append the text even if the note already holds it

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Text appended, or already there; `text` is the whole stored note, empty if none. On an archived track, without Prefer: handling=strict: nothing written, the stored note

400.description: Date or text invalid, or the note would be longer than 500 characters

409.description: The note kept changing while appending; nothing was written, try again

423.description: The track is archived; nothing written. Only for requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict, which otherwise get the 200 above

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.description: Every track gets an entry, also with no ticks, in track list order. Each is worked out up to the earliest of `to`, `today` and, for an archived track, its archive date; later ticks are ignored. With `from`, every day of the period from `from` takes part (unticked days at its start are a break), and streaks and breaks crossing either edge are cut there. Includes private tracks. Check the `statsPeriod` capability before sending `from` or `to`: older servers ignore them and answer all-time stats.

parameters.name: today
parameters.description: The client's date (YYYY-MM-DD); the server's date if omitted

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The period's first day (YYYY-MM-DD); from the first tick if omitted

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The period's last day (YYYY-MM-DD); up to today if omitted

parameters.name: trackId
parameters.description: One track only (also an archived one); 0 for all tracks

parameters.name: includeRuns
parameters.description: Add every streak and break to each entry

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: With all tracks, include archived ones

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Today, from or to is not a valid date, or from is after to

401.description: Current user is not logged in

put.description: The listed tracks come first, in the order sent; every other track of the user (archived ones included) follows in its previous order. Ids that aren't the user's are ignored. A list naming an archived track changes nothing: requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict get 423, others the active tracks in their current order.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Tracks reordered, active tracks returned in the new order. When an archived track is listed, without Prefer: handling=strict: nothing changed, active tracks in their current order

423.description: An archived track is listed; nothing changed. Only for requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict, which otherwise get the 200 above

401.description: Current user is not logged in

put.description: Change one thing per call. Several fields in one call are applied together, but this is strongly discouraged: an archived track refuses every change except a restore (`archived=false`) for clients that send `Prefer: handling=strict`, and a restore sent with a new name or private restores first and then applies them. Other clients get the unchanged track instead of the refusal.

archived.description: Archive (true) or restore (false) the track. A restored track goes to the end of the list. Archiving an archived track is refused (423) for clients that send Prefer: handling=strict

archivedAt.description: Archive date (YYYY-MM-DD), the client's today; the server's date if omitted

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Track ID

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Track updated. On an archived track, anything but a restore without Prefer: handling=strict: nothing changed, the unchanged track

423.description: The track is archived and this isn't a restore; nothing changed. Only for requests sent with Prefer: handling=strict, which otherwise get the 200 above

401.description: Current user is not logged in
